svg.title: The integrated lifecycle: disciplines by phase
svg.desc: The integrated lifecycle as a lane-by-phase grid. Joint: G0 17, G1 3, G2 4, G3 4, G4 1, G5 6, G6 1; Risk assessment: G0 2, G1 5, G2 0, G3 0, G4 0, G5 2, G6 0; Safety-related control: G0 0, G1 1, G2 8, G3 2, G4 6, G5 1, G6 0; Electrical & mechanical: G0 0, G1 0, G2 1, G3 4, G4 1, G5 0, G6 0; Software: G0 0, G1 0, G2 0, G3 7, G4 2, G5 0, G6 0; Cybersecurity: G0 1, G1 2, G2 1, G3 1, G4 0, G5 2, G6 1; Machine learning: G0 1, G1 1, G2 0, G3 1, G4 0, G5 1, G6 0; Independent confirmation: G0 0, G1 0, G2 0, G3 0, G4 0, G5 2, G6 0.

svg.text: Each cell is the number of activities the lane performs in the phase. Gates, roles and exit criteria are read from WP-M-00 and WP-M-02; nothing here is typed by hand.
